branch_conditions.notes: All fields are required; absence triggers null with note indicating missing key
Duplicate keys in input cause hard failure; no output produced
Only variants listed are valid; extra fields are silently dropped

empty_input.reason: No data present; transformation cannot proceed without input

single_record_input.reason: Single record is processed as a unit; all fields are absent by default

record_matching_multiple_variants.reason: Ambiguity in variant mapping leads to undefined behavior; transformation halts

record_matching_none_of_variants.reason: No valid input variant matches; record is rejected

filters.condition: raw_onboard_count is null or raw_activation_count is null or raw_push_count is null or raw_day7_return_count is null
filters.rationale: Raw counts are foundational for rate computation; missing values prevent recomputability

filters.condition: prior_week_total_onboard is null or prior_week_total_activation is null or prior_week_total_push is null or prior_week_total_day7_return is null
filters.rationale: Prior-week totals are required for delta computation; missing values render deltas uncomputable

clamps.rationale: Onboarding completion rate must be between 0% and 100%; outside bounds indicate instrumentation error
Activation rate must be between 0% and 100%; outside bounds indicate instrumentation error
Push enablement rate must be between 0% and 100%; outside bounds indicate instrumentation error
Day-7 return rate must be between 0% and 100%; outside bounds indicate instrumentation error

normalizations.rationale: Deltas are computed from raw count differences, not averaged daily rates; this ensures recomputability

interpolations.condition: raw_onboard_count is not null and prior_week_total_onboard is not null
interpolations.rationale: When raw counts are available, rate is recomputed from raw count ratio; this ensures full traceability

interpolations.condition: raw_activation_count is not null and prior_week_total_activation is not null
interpolations.rationale: When raw counts are available, rate is recomputed from raw count ratio; this ensures full traceability

interpolations.condition: raw_push_count is not null and prior_week_total_push is not null
interpolations.rationale: When raw counts are available, rate is recomputed from raw count ratio; this ensures full traceability

interpolations.condition: raw_day7_return_count is not null and prior_week_total_day7_return is not null
interpolations.rationale: When raw counts are available, rate is recomputed from raw count ratio; this ensures full traceability

instrumentation_issues.impact: Double-counted events lead to inflated raw counts; recomputed rates are invalid unless corrected by instrumentation note
instrumentation_issues.resolution_required: Instrumentation team must confirm whether double-fire is active and provide a correction factor or flag

instrumentation_issues.impact: Data loss during ingest leads to missing raw counts; deltas are invalid without prior-week totals and raw count correction
instrumentation_issues.resolution_required: Instrumentation team must confirm outage window and provide a gap period or data recovery plan

unmeasured_cells_policy.note_template: This metric was not measured in this cohort; instrumentation note: {{instrumentation_note}}
unmeasured_cells_policy.explanation: Zero-filling is a reportable defect and must be explicitly noted; no silent zero-fill allowed

missing_key_handling.message: Required field missing in input variant; transformation halts to prevent invalid state propagation

rate_computability_from_raw_counts.assertion: Every rate value must be recomputable from raw count and prior-week total
rate_computability_from_raw_counts.check_method: For each rate, verify that (raw_count / prior_week_total) equals the reported rate; if not, flag as invalid

delta_computability_from_summed_numerato.assertion: Every delta must be computed from (current_raw_count - prior_week_total) / prior_week_total
delta_computability_from_summed_numerato.check_method: For each delta, verify that the formula matches the reported value; if not, flag as invalid

total_reconciliation_with_components.assertion: Sum of raw counts must equal prior-week total plus current week count (accounting for ingest gaps)
total_reconciliation_with_components.check_method: For each metric, verify that: raw_count = prior_week_total + current_week_raw_count

no_zero_fills_for_unmeasured_cells.assertion: No unmeasured cell is filled with zero; all missing values are null with explanatory note
no_zero_fills_for_unmeasured_cells.check_method: Scan for any value that is 0.0 and has no raw count or prior-week total; if found, flag as defect

ordering_rules.input_ordering: records are processed in the order received from the weekly extract
ordering_rules.field_processing_order: fields are processed in alphabetical order by target field name

rounding_rules.precision: all rates and deltas are rounded to exactly four decimal places

serialization_rules.format: all numeric values are serialized as strings with four decimal places (e.g., '0.8645')
serialization_rules.unit_labels: unit is included in field label; unitless numbers are treated as defects
serialization_rules.timestamp_format: if present, timestamps follow ISO 8601 format

idempotency.behavior: repeated application of the transformation produces identical output for same input
idempotency.reason: all rules are deterministic and stateless; no side effects or caching is used
idempotency.exception_case: no exception cases exist due to absence of mutable state

definitions.rate: a metric expressed as a decimal between 0.0 and 1.0, representing the proportion of events completed or activated relative to total registrations
definitions.delta: the percentage change from prior week to current week, computed from raw count differences using summed numerators
definitions.raw_count: the actual number of users who experienced an event in a given cohort, as captured by instrumentation
definitions.prior_week_total: the total number of users recorded for the same metric during the previous week

evidence_recency.validity_period: as of this engagement; no assumption of staleness or change over time
